description: This file contains the implementation of the MySQLi database connection class as part of the Opencart system's database library. It provides methods for connecting to a MySQL database, executing queries, escaping strings, and retrieving metadata such as last insert ID and affected rows.

classes.name: MySQLi
classes.description: A class encapsulating MySQL database connection and query execution using mysqli extension, with support for SSL options and safe resource management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new MySQLi connection with provided hostname, username, password, database, port, and SSL options, setting session modes and handling SSL certificates.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and returns the result set, encapsulating fetch operations and error handling.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe use in SQL statements.

methods.name: countAffected
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last query.

methods.name: getLastId
methods.description: Retrieves the ID generated by the last INSERT operation.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the database connection is currently active.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the database connection when the object is destroyed, ensuring proper resource cleanup.
